  • Architect and operate scalable, self-healing infrastructure leveraging Kubernetes, Terraform, and cloud-native tools across multi-region deployments.

  • Drive AI enablement across engineering — ensuring repos, tooling, and workflows are optimized for agentic development with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.

About the Role

As Controller at Alchemy, you'll be responsible for building and leading our end-to-end accounting function.

Leading a growing team, you’ll be responsible for our core accounting operations, strengthening the systems and controls that support the business, and transforming complex financial information into clear insights for company leadership, our Board of Directors, and investors. The ideal candidate combines deep technical accounting expertise with strong business judgment. You’ll be equally comfortable setting the long-term direction of the function, partnering across the company, and rolling up your sleeves to solve challenging accounting and operational problems.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Set the strategy and long-term direction for Alchemy’s accounting function, systems, and team.

  • Assume full responsibility for routine financial operations, encompassing the general ledger, AP, AR, and reporting, while managing complex multi-entity and multi-currency consolidations for global operations, including our presence in Romania.

  • Own timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.

  • Ensure financial statements and accounting practices comply with US GAAP and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Architect and refine a scalable accounting infrastructure by managing and optimizing our core financial technology stack, including NetSuite, Orb, Zip, and Ramp.

  • Develop policies, procedures, and controls that promote financial accuracy, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and strong risk management.

  • Oversee tax planning, compliance, and preparation in partnership with internal stakeholders and external advisors.

  • Lead relationships with third-party accounting firms, auditors, tax advisors, and other financial service providers.

  • Develop and present reporting that gives company leaders meaningful insight into financial and operational performance, and partner with Finance on Board and investor reporting.

  • Distill complex financial information into clear recommendations that support strategic decision-making.

  • Lead technical accounting and strategic initiatives, including revenue recognition, vendor analysis, customer analysis, and other special projects.

  • Collaborate closely with teams across Alchemy, including Finance, Operations, Sales, People, Engineering, and Product.

  • Lead, develop, and scale the capabilities of a high-performing accounting team, fostering ownership, rigor, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, with leadership experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, Head of Accounting, Accounting Director, or similar senior accounting role.

  • Public accounting experience paired with meaningful in-house operating experience at a high-growth technology company.

  • Strong ownership of accounting operations, including general ledger, AP, AR, consolidations, financial reporting, and close processes.

  • Deep technical accounting knowledge, including US GAAP and experience applying accounting guidance to complex business transactions.

  • Experience building scalable accounting systems, processes, policies, and internal controls with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and scalability.

  • Audit-readiness experience or strong ability to prepare a company for future audits, including documentation, controls, reporting infrastructure, and close discipline.

  • Strong business judgment, with the ability to connect detailed accounting work to broader company strategy and decision-making.

  • Hands-on operating style, comfortable rolling up their sleeves in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to partner cross-functionally and explain complex financial topics clearly to leadership, Board members, investors, and cross-functional partners.

  • People leadership experience, including leading, developing, and raising the bar for an accounting team.

 

Nice to Haves

  • CPA strongly preferred.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or later-stage private company, ideally Series C/D/E.

  • NetSuite experience preferred but not required.

  • Experience with billing, procurement, and expense management systems.

  • Experience with crypto, digital assets, blockchain, or web3 is a plus, but not required.

  • Experience managing external tax, technical accounting, M&A, audit, or advisory partners.

 

Benefits and Perks

🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision
💪 Gym Reimbursement
🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget
🥙 In-Office Group Meals
🚅 Commuter Benefits
🌴 Flexible Time Off
🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks
🧠 Learning & Development Stipend
🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events
💸 HSA and FSA Plans
🧬 Fertility Benefits

Alchemy is committed to offering competitive compensation, including base salary as well as equity. Additionally, Alchemy offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited flexible time off.

  • Familiarity with Alchemy's product suite (RPC, Gasless Transactions, Data APIs, Webhooks, etc.).

  • Experience managing or influencing channel partnerships with major cloud/tech providers (AWS, GCP, etc.).

  • Background in developer relations or developer-focused marketing.

  • Existing presence and influence on Crypto Twitter / X and within key Web3 communities.

🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision
💪 Gym Reimbursement
🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget
🥙 In-Office Group Meals
🚅 Commuter Benefits
🌴 Flexible Time Off
🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks

🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events
💸 HSA and FSA Plans
🧬 Fertility Benefits

About the role

Self-serve is how Alchemy grows. The dashboard and the developer experience around it are the primary revenue engine for our flagship products: developers discover us, sign up, get to their first call, scale their usage, and upgrade largely without ever talking to a person. That funnel is one of the most direct levers on company-level revenue we have, and this role owns it.

It's also changing fast. A growing share of developers now reach Alchemy through an AI coding agent rather than a browser tab, and we expect agent-mediated usage to become the dominant way our platform is consumed. Building for that shift, our MCP server, agent skills, and AI-native onboarding, sits squarely in this role.

  • The dashboard. Own signup, app creation, first key, first call, usage and CU visibility, upgrade paths, team management, and the observability developers need to debug their own traffic.

  • Developer experience end to end. Docs, SDKs, quickstarts, error messages, sandbox and testnet flows, and the first hour of every integration. Reduce time to first successful call, then time to first paid workload.

  • The truth. Get into the warehouse yourself. Build the funnel, find the cohort that doesn't behave like the average, and bring back the answer nobody wanted to hear.

About the role

You'll own a 0→1 product surface at Alchemy, from the first customer conversation to GA to a self-serve growth engine. This is a builder's seat. You'll define the wedge, write the spec, sit with design and engineering daily, get on calls with developers and CTOs, and carry the number that proves it worked. You'll have real latitude to shape the roadmap, so this role suits someone who's comfortable defining the problem as well as solving it

What you'll do

 - Go 0→1. Take an ambiguous opportunity such as agentic payments, stablecoin rails, data APIs, or a new chain ecosystem, and turn it into a shipped product with real usage and real revenue.

 - Sell, build, and deliver. Run discovery calls, join sales calls, write the pitch, then go build what you promised and make sure it lands in production.

 - Be the voice of the developer. Live in support channels, GitHub issues, customer Slack channels, and your own terminal. Ship product that engineers choose without a sales call.

 - Set the bar on quality and speed. Define what great looks like for latency, reliability, and DX, then hold the line while moving fast.

 - Make the call. Decide with incomplete information, write down why, and revisit when the data changes.

What we're looking for

 - 5+ years in product, with meaningful time on a developer platform, API, or infrastructure product. You've shipped things engineers integrate, not just use.

 - Demonstrated product-led growth experience: self-serve funnels, activation and conversion metrics, pricing and packaging, usage-based monetization.

 - Founder mentality. You've started something, whether a company, a business line, or a product nobody asked you to build.

 - Bias to action. You move quickly to get to a real answer: fast customer validation, clear evidence of demand, then a committed build with a path to revenue. Speed comes from cutting cycle time, not from cutting quality.

 - Customer obsessed and commercially fluent. Comfortable in a sales call, a design review, and a production incident on the same day.

 - Thrives in ambiguity. You create the structure rather than wait for it.

 - Technical enough to read an API spec, write a curl request, prototype with an AI coding agent, and hold your own with senior engineers.

 - Crypto and web3 experience is a plus. Deep curiosity is required.
